newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - high sulphur well supplied.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - high sulphur well supplied.

text.p: Straight-run fuel oil activity was slow on Friday with recent industry functions taking their toll.
Prices were under pressure with some grades below cracked levels because of their availability.

An M-40 was sold at $122 cif Rotterdam, the price reflecting its high water content. An E-4 was sold at formula +$2.65 cif NWE and others are available towards the end of the month. "I don't think it would be difficult to secure an E-4," said one trader.
Low sulphur straight-run was pegged steady in the low $140s fob NWE, but very quiet. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8980
